text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan, who had 
been close friends since childhood.

Watching the GⅠ race,
the two are reminded 
once again that every Umamusume runs with 
fierce determination and strong feelings 
in her heart.

Heading toward the Classics, they became 
more keenly aware of one another than
ever 
before.
